messages:
nina (AE): Prospect VRM asked for audit export + immutability wording and a tiny sample log for their security review. Can we confirm what we can share for PoC?

omar (SE): We can provide an S3 export (ndjson gz), a live syslog forward, and a redacted sample.

rachel (InfoSec): Suggested SIG blurb: \"Administrative and API activities are logged and can be exported to customer-managed S3 or forwarded to customer SIEMs. Hosted default retention 90 days; Dedicated/Private allow custom retention and WORM-capable targets. Exports include checksums and signed manifests for tamper-evidence.\"

ben (SRE): Export details: ndjson gz files, file-level sha256, manifest signed by pipeline key. We can create a time-stamped signed bundle for PoC (ticket required).

nina (AE): Customer asked for a sample showing key rotation, a deploy, and a failed auth. Can we produce a 3-line redacted sample?

omar (SE): I'll paste a tiny redacted excerpt for the PDF.

```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-19T22:15:04Z","actor":"admin@example.com","action":"key.rotate","request_id":"req_01","outcome":"success"}
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T03:02:11Z","actor":"svc-deploy","action":"model.deploy","request_id":"req_02","outcome":"success"}
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T05:10:52Z","actor":"unknown","action":"auth.token","request_id":"req_03","outcome":"failure"}
```

nina (AE): Good. Pricing note? Procurement wants to know if PoC exports cost extra.

vrm-bot (automated): PoC exports are typically covered under onboarding credits; sustained exports incur egress/config fees. See pricing link.

rachel (InfoSec): Add one line about prompt privacy: we store truncated prompt snippets and token hashes, never full raw prompt in exported logs.

nina (AE): Great — I'll assemble the PDF with this excerpt + SIG blurb + ops note. Target: EOD tomorrow. Thanks all.
